name: Saved desktop layouts
author: aishag80g-stack
description: Save your desktop with its apps — from a screenshot or live — and restore it with one click: apps launch and land exactly where you left them, desktop ready to work.

barWidget.description: Left-click restores your saved desktop: every assigned app launches and lands at its stored position, ready to work. Right-click lists saved layouts. Define layouts with the bundled CLI (from a screenshot or the current desktop); geometry is relative, so it works at any resolution.
